correctness.rationale: The zero-leaf obstruction follows simultaneously from restraint and Italian defense. Admissible zero-core sets are precisely induced subgraphs of minimum degree at least one, and the boundary parameter counts zero cores whose leaf is allowed weight 1. Product contributions give every weight coefficient; minimum exponent and unit lowest coefficients classify minimizers. Binary run decompositions prove closed formulas on paths and cycles, including small endpoints; 80 directly enumerated graphs and path/cycle orders through 18 agree independently of the symbolic proof.

originality.rationale: The claimed advance is the entire one-leaf-corona RID weight enumerator expressed by admissible induced zero-core sets and their internal vertex boundary, together with the complete optimum-labeling censuses on combs and sunlets. The 2020 introductory preprint and 2023 scalar studies provide the parameter but not this full polynomial in the material inspected. A 2023/2024 paper says its scalar results include some corona graphs and has not been examined in full, so overlapping scalar consequences remain possible; it cannot by abstract alone be asserted to imply or to exclude the full census. Closest accessible records about other domination variants have distinct feasible objects. Searches of aliases, formulas, broader statements and enumerators did not identify an equivalent claim; this is a qualified literature-based assessment, not uniqueness certification.
residual_risks: Complete text of 2023-online/2024-journal Abdulhasan–Mojdeh paper was not available: possible scalar or coefficient overlap cannot be excluded.
Some full texts and unindexed dissertations/tables may contain a stronger equivalent theorem despite negative accessible searches.
Computational checks cover only finitely many instances; mathematical correctness relies on the complete proof, not exhaustive machine certification.

value.rationale: The coefficientwise function-count polynomial on all one-leaf coronas is a natural refinement of the restrained Italian domination number, encoding the geometry of induced zero sets and internal vertex boundaries. It determines all optimizers, resolves count and congruence transitions on two canonical infinite families, and detects the structural universal-vertex equality case. These have mathematical meaning independent of finite checker correctness or formal novelty.
